basic_info.description: Welcome to 1500 Francisco St #3, a charming condo in the heart of San Francisco's coveted Marina neighborhood. (Earthquake insurance included and not in liquefaction!)   Natural light pours through Bay windows, highlighting hardwood floors and classic wainscoting. But, period charm doesn't mean sacrificing on modern amenities: the spacious living area flows seamlessly for relaxing, dining, or entertaining. A custom bar cabinet sets the stage for cozy dinner parties, and the updated kitchen offers ample storage and timeless style.  The peaceful bedroom is a true retreat after a long day, while the bathroom has been tastefully updated. You'll also love the in-unit laundry, massive walk-in closet, 1-car parking, additional storage unit, and well-managed building.  Step outside to all the best of the Marina with unbeatable walkability to Fort Mason's farmers market, Marina Green, Crissy Field, the Golden Gate Bridge, plus vibrant shops, cafs, and restaurants on Chestnut and Union.  Whether you're a first-time buyer, investor, or looking for a stylish and low-maintenance home base, this condo checks all the boxes. A rare find in a beloved neighborhood!
